subject: Exclusive Offer Inside: 20% Off Your Next Purchase!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to offer you an exclusive discount of 20% off your next purchase at our online store. Simply use the code SAVE20 at checkout to redeem your savings. This limited-time offer is our way of showing appreciation for your continued support. Browse our latest collection and treat yourself to something special today! We look forward to serving you again soon.
